lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, maintaining a regular grid-like relative spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral midsection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal features with sharp vertical intensity gradients (light superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) are visible running along the upper third of the flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark vertical linear feature, potentially a scar or deep tissue indentation, is visible on the upper flank just behind the head.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of high-luminance spots of varying sizes, with the largest clusters located near the anterior edge.
